executive_assessment.text: WFP consulted Trio communities around Kwamalasamutu and Saamaka communities along the Upper Suriname river on livelihood and supply-chain risks.
Low river levels during drought restrict boat access to remote Indigenous and Maroon villages, raising transport costs and disrupting essential supplies.
Recurrent coastal and rainfall flooding threatens livelihoods and services; Greater Paramaribo faces insufficient drainage capacity and maintenance.

geographic_notes.text: Greater Paramaribo: Recurrent coastal and rainfall flooding threatens livelihoods and services; Greater Paramaribo faces insufficient drainage capacity and maintenance.
Paramaribo; Saramacca; Wanica: The 2025 project planned community-led resilience activities in Paramaribo, Saramacca and Wanica, including women-led initiatives.
Suriname interior: Low river levels during drought restrict boat access to remote Indigenous and Maroon villages, raising transport costs and disrupting essential supplies.
Kwamalasamutu; Upper Suriname river: WFP consulted Trio communities around Kwamalasamutu and Saamaka communities along the Upper Suriname river on livelihood and supply-chain risks.
Kwamalasamutu: Trio knowledge and local governance practices support environmental stewardship, adaptation and social cohesion.
Paramaribo historical centre: Paramaribo's waterfront adaptation project links flood protection with heritage, transport access and livelihoods around the Central Market.
